evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the document type.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the edited document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with additional information.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an attachment.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.description: Mark and archive attachments with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.description: Assign group- and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.description: Allocate workflow participants in document properties.

evts.name: assign_user_to_user_group
evts.description: Assign users to role-related user groups.

evts.description: Start the workflow-supported three-step release process for a document.

evts.description: Reviewers check the document in the review step.

evts.description: Releasers approve and release the document.

evts.description: Reject a review or release task, canceling subsequent workflow participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document.

evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.description: Manage and edit assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the valid-until date.

evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a new version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.description: Create a request for AKS to invalidate a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Workflow process for the request for AKS.

evts.name: invalidate_document

evts.description: Revoke all rights except for the archive group during archiving.

evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period expires.

evts.description: Create a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Workflow process to confirm reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons on the distribution list for a document.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Send e-mail notifications to users for workflow, release, change proposal, distribution, validity extension, or acknowledgement.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipients actively confirm acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: list_documents
evts.description: List all documents relevant to a user in the document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_details
evts.description: Display details such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents and language versions.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements in reports.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_language_version
evts.description: Check and release a translated language version with workflow support.
